messages.author: 2b6ce28377994fcc
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] output methylBaseDB object as a data matrix
parts:
Hi Alex,

Here is what I did. First, I created a methylDB object to list all the files. Next is to unite all samples. When the destrand is set to TRUE, it stops to build *_destrand.txt.bgz (error message is below). 

compressing the file with bgzip...

making tabix index...

compressing the file with bgzip...

making tabix index...

[ti_index_core] the file out of order at line 696251

Error in value[[3L]](cond) : 

  internal: samtools invoked 'exit(1)'; see warnings() and restart R

  file: /home/shens/CpG/cpgDB/celltype1_destrand.txt.bgz

Calls: unite ... tryCatch -> tryCatchList -> tryCatchOne -> <Anonymous>

Execution halted


The original files are bed format and sorted by sortBed of bedtools. Everything will be ok if destrand parameter turned off. This is why I am suspicious there might be an issue between destrand parameter and tabix. Hope this helps.

Thanks,
Steve
